name: Myrrh
overview: Myrrh, a fragrant resin from the land of Canaan, is highlighted in Scripture as a valuable spice used in various sacred and practical contexts. It was a key ingredient in the holy anointing oil prescribed in Exodus, symbolizing consecration and holiness. The fragrance of myrrh also marked occasions of purification and celebration, as seen in Esther and Psalms, and it was notably presented to Jesus by the wise men, signifying honor and prophetic significance. Additionally, myrrh’s use in embalming and as a perfume underscores its role in both honoring the living and preparing the dead.
